widgets_values: The shot starts low behind a rain-slicked rooftop, the manta-ray mothership looming huge and close in the frame, its three underside lights pulsing through the fog. The camera rises smoothly and continuously, tilting up as it climbs, the rooftop falling away below. As it ascends, the fog thins and the full scale of the mothership is revealed, escort craft circling it in slow orbits like fish around a whale. The camera keeps rising until it breaks through the top layer of fog into pale dawn light, and the mothership is seen whole from above, casting a vast shadow over the miniature city below. One continuous rising move, never cutting. Deep sub-bass drone that opens up into airy orchestral swell at the fog break, engine hum, wind rushing past.
